mapper.select:
SELECT a.`id` `conferenceId`, a.`name` `conferenceName`, a.`capacity` `capacity` FROM conference a where a.`status` = 0
and a.`name` like concat('%', #{param.keyword}, '%')
and (a.book_person is null or a.book_person like concat('%', #{param.userId}, '%')
or
a.book_person like concat('%', #{id}, '%')
or
a.book_person like concat('%', #{id}, '%')
) order by a.`create_time` desc

SELECT distinct a.`id` `conferenceId`, a.`area_name` `areaName`, a.`capacity` `capacity`, a.`name` `name` FROM `conference` a where a.`status` = 0 and (a.book_person is null or a.book_person like concat('%', #{param.userId}, '%')
or
a.book_person like concat('%', #{id}, '%')
or
a.book_person like concat('%', #{id}, '%')
)

SELECT cf.`id` `conferenceId`, cf.`area_name` `areaName`, cf.`capacity` `capacity`, cf.`name` `name`, d.`new_salary` `conferenceBookStatus` FROM `conference` cf LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.`conference_id`, ( CASE WHEN a.num = b.num THEN 'NOAPPOINTMENT' ELSE 'AVALIABLE' END ) `new_salary` FROM ( SELECT `conference_id`, COUNT( `time_interval` ) `num` FROM `book_time_interval` GROUP BY `conference_id` ) a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT bir.`conference_id`, COUNT( bir.`time_interval` ) `num` FROM `book_interval_record` bir LEFT JOIN `book_room` br ON bir.`book_id` = br.`id` where bir.`appointment_date` = #{param.date} and br.`status` = 'RESERVED'
and bir.`time_interval` not in
#{item}
GROUP BY bir.`conference_id` ) b ON a.`conference_id` = b.`conference_id` ) d ON cf.`id` = d.`conference_id` order by `conferenceBookStatus` ASC

SELECT cf.`id` `conferenceId`, cf.`area_name` `areaName`, cf.`capacity` `capacity`, cf.`name` `name`, cd.`deviceName` `deviceName` FROM `conference` cf LEFT JOIN (SELECT
WM_CONCAT(`name`) `deviceName`,
GROUP_CONCAT(`name`) `deviceName`,
`conference_id` FROM `conference_device` where `conference_id` = #{id}) cd on cf.`id` = cd.`conference_id`
where cf.id = #{id}

SELECT `conference_id` as `conferenceId`,
WM_CONCAT(`name`) `deviceName`,
GROUP_CONCAT( `name` ) as `name`
FROM `conference_device` where `conference_id` in
#{item}
GROUP BY `conference_id`
